Rock Ridge Scalloped Trim Towel Bars

text.description_html:
Fusion TB-G1-ORB, Arched Rock Ridge Towel Bar

Made out of sandcast brass, this Arched Rock Ridge Towel Bar has an oil rubbed bronze finish. It is available in 3 sizes: a 18 inch, a 20 inch, and a 24 inch. The Sandcast Brass Scalloped Trim Towel Bar is built to last; after all, it is made by Fusion who is known for their quality pieces. Add a traditional touch to your bathroom.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TR-G1 Rock Ridge Towel Ring, Fusion RH-G1 Rock Ridge Robe Hook, and Fusion PH-G1 Rock Ridge Toilet Paper Holder

Features and Specifications of the Rock Ridge Sandcast Brass Scalloped Trim Towel Bar:

  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

Available in 2 sizes:

    TB-1-G1
    • Length: 18"
    • Mount Width: 2-7/8"
    • Mount Length: 3-5/8"

    TB-2-G1
    • Length: 24"
    • Mount Width: 2-7/8"
    • Mount Length: 3-5/8"

    TB-3-G1
    • Length: 30"
    • Mount Width: 2-7/8"
    • Mount Length: 3-5/8"

Sold Individually
